title: ColoredPing
description: Makes the ping icon colored depending on the player's ping.
body:
A simple resource pack for Minecraft 1.21.9 and newer that changes the color of the ping icon depending on the player's ping.

![Ping colors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/57NrQi0M/images/d525a84750929c283249afbcad1c29ce9748101b.gif)
